'''Basteel''' was a temperate, bleak [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where [[Slique Brighteyes]] hid from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mir Tork]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Leonis Murthé]]. Not long after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Slique hired [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to kill Mir and Leonis for 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Fett returned with their heads just before Slique died.
